facts.fact: 朱迪思把奥利弗·贝雷斯福德案的证物撤下，换成加里、贝思尼与哈里的照片

facts.fact: 朱迪思承认两天前有个自称是她继女的女人找上门

facts.fact: 朱迪思承认当天上过菲利波斯的船，但在菲利波斯离港前已回到栈桥
facts.anchor: I went on his boat that day. But I was back on the jetty by the time he left.

facts.fact: 朱迪思推断拍照者另有其人，就藏在附近
facts.anchor: There must have been someone else hiding nearby who took the photo.

facts.fact: 塔妮卡说加里的短信通话记录本来平淡，直到发现一段被归档的对话
facts.anchor: They’re all pretty vanilla – or so we thought until we found a text conversation that he’d archived.

facts.fact: 贝克斯判断勒索者在十八号见面时杀死了加里，阻止他说出身份
facts.anchor: So, when they met up on the eighteenth, they killed him to make sure that he never would.

facts.anchor: He can’t have been involved in any kind of road traffic accident or we’d have picked that up in background checks.

facts.fact: 塔妮卡说档案有纸质硬拷贝存在雷丁郊外仓库
facts.anchor: Although, even if the digital record was deleted, we keep hard copies of all of our files in a warehouse just outside Reading.
